title: Counit-induced global Hom adjunction with independent localization universes
statement: Let X,Y be qcqs schemes, f:X→Y, and a a right adjoint to the QCoh derived direct image [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. For P∈D_QCoh(X), K∈D_QCoh(Y), normalized inverse Leray followed by the evaluation-mate direct-image internal Hom comparison [lem-sc-mixed-hom-direct-image-comparison] and Hom of the counit is an isomorphism res_f RHom_X(P,aK)→RHom_Y(Rf_*P,K). The global-module and sheaf derived localization universes are independent [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso].

proof.text: Choose the evaluation-mate comparison, uniquely determined by its equation; form the counit-induced map and inverse Leray. This chooses determined comparison data rather than an arbitrary existence witness.

Apply qcqsSheafRHomAdjunction with the fixed tensor adjunctions, mixed tensorator and its defining mate equation. It shows that the internal Hom comparison followed by Hom of the counit becomes invertible under the quasi-coherator.

Apply dqCoherator_isIso_derivedGlobalSections in the chosen independent global localization universe. Combine its conclusion with inverse normalized Leray and functoriality of global sections to prove invertibility of the exact counit-induced global map.
